summary: Mistwalker and Microsoft's Akira Toriyama-designed RPG series, covering the Xbox 360 original and two Nintendo DS follow-ups.

entries.title: Blue Dragon

emulation.notes: Use official Xbox backward compatibility rather than unofficial 360 emulation.

primary.why: Blue Dragon is an Xbox 360 exclusive that is supported by Xbox backward compatibility; Series X/S gives the best current official hardware route.
primary.how_to_play: Play an owned physical or digital Xbox 360 copy through Xbox One or Xbox Series X/S backward compatibility. Use Disc 1 for physical installs where required.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster exists; this is a backward-compatible Xbox 360 release.
